description: Compare AEO posture across multiple URLs (e.g. a brand versus its competitors) on the same FIND/READ/USE pillar scale. Async: returns an audit_id to poll with get_audit. Spends credits only for freshly-audited URLs; recent audits are reused uncharged.
name: compare_aeo

audit_id.description: The first child audit id (poll each child with get_audit).

child_audit_ids.description: All child audit ids, in input order.

eta_ms.description: Estimated time to completion in ms (0 when all cached).

reused_audit_ids.description: Child ids served from cache (not charged).

suggested_next_calls.description: Advisory next-tool-call pointers (suggested_next_calls). Score-neutral agent UX.

reason.description: Why this is the natural next step.

title: Compare AEO Across URLs
